pooling: attention-mask mean followed by L2 normalization
purpose: Symmetric opportunity paraphrase retrieval; vector similarity is never an identity verdict.
titles: Excluded from embedding identity; retained by the independent lexical path.
constraints: Preserved and checked by deterministic pair review, not erased by the encoder.
fusion: Equal round-robin union of exact identities, dense rank and lexical rank, de-duplicated by stable opportunity ID; exact identities first.
pairEvaluation: Every one of the 140 frozen left queries against all 140 frozen right records. Same-task variants can legitimately share top ranks; record exact paired-target recall separately.
selectionPolicy: Report development and held-out domains separately. Preserve misses; do not tune on held-out results or change labels to fit the model.
externalCalls: Only public pinned model/dependency downloads. Embedding inference is local; no paid model calls planned.
semanticReview: Existing grounded review and explicit constraints remain authoritative. Retrieval is incomplete above the bounded exhaustive set.
limitations: Authored synthetic data and shared-host performance are not independent human acceptance, natural-language prevalence or market evidence. A new corpus is required before claiming broad generalization.
